english: Tric Gabay uses your name, email and phone to manage your account and trip contact. Pickup and trip location are used for matching, navigation and safety; background location is requested only for driver service. Driver identity and vehicle documents are reviewed by authorised administrators. Supabase stores account and trip records; Mapbox processes route coordinates; GCash payments go directly from tourist to driver, and Tric Gabay keeps the GCash reference number and any proof you submit for payment disputes; Firebase supports notifications. Optional crash and performance diagnostics may include device and app information; the app does not attach contact details, pickup codes, precise location or payment details to diagnostic reports. You may decline diagnostics and still book. Account deletion removes profile details, documents and avatars, and disconnects retained trip and financial records from your account. Financial transaction identifiers and amounts remain under the operator retention policy; provider copies and backups follow their own policies. For privacy or deletion help, use Help & support in your account.
filipino: Ginagamit ng Tric Gabay ang pangalan, email at telepono mo para sa account at pakikipag-ugnayan sa biyahe. Ginagamit ang eksaktong lokasyon para sa pickup, paghahanap ng driver, ruta at kaligtasan. Kailangan lamang ang background location habang nagseserbisyo ang driver. Sinusuri ng awtorisadong administrador ang mga dokumento ng driver at sasakyan. Supabase ang imbakan, Mapbox ang tagapagproseso ng ruta, diretso sa driver ang bayad sa GCash (itinatago ang reference number at patunay na isinumite mo para sa reklamo sa bayad), at Firebase ang mga abiso. Opsyonal ang crash diagnostics; maaari kang tumanggi at mag-book pa rin. Hindi isinasama sa diagnostic reports ang contact details, pickup code, eksaktong lokasyon o detalye ng bayad. Inaalis ng account deletion ang login, personal na profile, dokumento at avatar. Inihihiwalay sa account ang mga kailangang panatilihing tala ng biyahe at transaksiyon. Nananatili ang mga halaga at provider reference ayon sa patakaran ng operator; hiwalay ang mga patakaran ng provider at backup. Gamitin ang Help & support para sa mga tanong sa privacy.
